notes: 1. SCOPE: Buyer Portal Project Information is a READ-ONLY content page at https://uat.xrportal.in/project (Buyer host — NOT uat-web). It requires an authenticated buyer session; unauthenticated access redirects to '/'. Content is published by Admin via Strapi CMS. Buyers cannot edit, upload, download-manage or otherwise mutate anything on this page (FS 1.5 Rule 1, BRD Module 8).

2. BUYER AUTH: Mobile-OTP only (no password). UAT mobile = 8888888888, UAT static OTP = 147258 (Buyer/CP share 147258; this is NOT the SM/Admin 258369). JWT is stored in sessionStorage and carried on API calls (BRD §7). This module performs no auth itself — it inherits the session from Registration & Login.

3. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable / state-dependent UAT artefact must be supplied before executing this test (e.g. a Strapi project with NO published gallery images, a project with isActive=false, an expired document SAS URL, a fresh-published Strapi item to verify reload, or a valid buyer API bearer token).
4. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour is described in BRD/FS/FRD but NOT confirmed against the live UI in visual-memory (or vice-versa); confirm with dev before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative.

5. DOC_DRIFT-001 (MAJOR — live UI vs FS/FRD) — The FS (BUYER-FS-Project-Information §1.4) and BRD/FRD (Module 8) describe a TABBED layout with five tabs: Overview / Towers / Gallery / Documents / Videos, plus a photo lightbox, RERA/brochure document DOWNLOADS, and tower-spec tables. The live captured page (visual-memory/buyer/project-information/INDEX.md, captured 2026-06-03, re-verified 2026-06-06, CAPTURE_STATUS FULL) shows NO tabs, NO lightbox, NO downloadable-documents section and NO tower-spec tables. It is a single scrolling content-only page of embedded videos + images with these sections in order: project heading 'HoABL Naigaon' (RERA ID: P99000080106) → 'See the Vision Come Alive' (Explore Project Videos & Walkthrough, video 06.45) → 'LOCATION' / 'Epicentre of Growth' (video 03.39) → 'PROJECT WALKTHROUGH' / 'Your Future Growth Home – Development Walkthrough' → 'SCIENCE BEHIND EVERY DETAIL' / 'Integrated Project Planning for 1 BHK' → 'SCIENCE BEHIND EVERY DETAIL' / 'Integrated Project Planning for 2 BHK'. LIVE UI WINS: legacy BYR_PROJ_* TCs that assert tabs/lightbox/document-download/tower-spec tables are RETAINED (never renumbered) but their Expected results are reframed to the live page and flagged [VERIFY WITH DEV] / DOC_DRIFT-001 — confirm whether the tabbed layout is a different (CP) build, an unreleased variant, or stale documentation. BUYER-FS-Project-Information and BUYER-FRD Module 8 should be updated to match the live content-only page.

6. DOC_DRIFT-002 — FS lists a 'Documents' section with RERA registration, approvals and downloadable brochures, and the FS 'How to Use' Step 3 says buyers can 'view and download RERA registration and other official documents'. The live page exposes NO documents/downloads section; the only RERA artefact visible is the textual 'RERA ID: P99000080106' shown under the project heading. Document-download TCs (BYR_PROJ_016/017/048) are retained but re-scoped to [VERIFY WITH DEV] — confirm whether downloads exist behind a video/section not captured, or were removed.

7. NOT THIS MODULE: This is the ACTIVE Buyer → Project Information module. Do NOT confuse with the DEPRECATED Channel-Partner project-information module. Strapi itself is OUT OF SCOPE for testing (CLAUDE.md constraint 2) — only the downstream rendered effect on the Buyer page is tested here. LeadSquared is excluded entirely.

8. NOTIFICATIONS: This page is informational and read-only — viewing it dispatches NO SMS / WhatsApp / email / push (silent by design). Any 'silent' assertion here is a silence-by-design REQUIRED case, not a missing-toast defect (CLAUDE.md Pipeline Discipline 6).

9. CONTENT SOURCE: Per FRD §5 Module 8 and BRD §8 Integrations, gallery/documents/videos are managed via Strapi CMS and projectId is environment-bound (BYR_PROJ_026/029 reference a hardcoded Strapi project id of 1 on UAT). Empty-state and Strapi-outage behaviour are documented as graceful-fallback expectations but the exact on-screen strings are not transcribed in visual-memory — those Expected results carry [VERIFY WITH DEV].

10. GLOSSARY: 'Project' = the sidebar nav item that opens /project (sidebar order: Home | Registration | Allotment | Homeloan | Project | Work Progress | Logout). 'Logout' = button.ant-btn matching /logout/i. 'Hero/Vision video' = the 'See the Vision Come Alive' player (06.45). 'LOCATION video' = the 'Epicentre of Growth' player (03.39). 'RERA ID' = the textual 'RERA ID: P99000080106' under the 'HoABL Naigaon' heading. Captured baseline viewport = 1920×900 (desktop).

tcs.steps:
1. Log in to the Buyer portal at https://uat.xrportal.in/.
2. Click 'Project' in the navigation.
3. Wait for the page to finish loading.
tcs.expected: The Project Information page loads at https://uat.xrportal.in/project and shows the project heading 'HoABL Naigaon' with the content sections below; no error or blank page is shown.
